adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler, decrypted `keys` are `JSON.parse(...)`d and then persisted directly to `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: keys } })` / `create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })` without any per-app schema validation (the only checks are `userId/appSlug` via zod and presence of app metadata). This means a caller with the webhook secret can store arbitrary credential shapes that downstream app services (which expect specific zod-parsed structures) may not be able to consume, causing broken integrations or runtime failures.
